    w = observation.get("grid_width", 0)
    h = observation.get("grid_height", 0)
    s = observation.get("self_position", (0, 0))
    o = observation.get("opponent_position", (0, 0))
    rs = observation.get("resources", [])
    obs = observation.get("obstacles", [])
    sp = observation.get("self_path", [])
    oppp = observation.get("opponent_path", [])

    def p(v):
        return v if isinstance(v, (list, tuple)) and len(v) >= 2 else None

    def sgn(v):
        return 0 if v == 0 else (1 if v > 0 else -1)

    def bad(x, y):
        return x < 0 or y < 0 or x >= w or y >= h or (x, y) in ob

    ob = set()
    for v in obs:
        q = p(v)
        if q is not None:
            ob.add((q[0], q[1]))

    targets = []
    for v in rs:
        q = p(v)
        if q is not None:
            targets.append((q[0], q[1]))
    if not targets:
        return [0, 0]

    best = targets[0]
    bd = abs(best[0] - s[0]) + abs(best[1] - s[1])
    for t in targets[1:]:
        d = abs(t[0] - s[0]) + abs(t[1] - s[1])
        if d < bd or (d == bd and t < best):
            best, bd = t, d

    cand = []
    dx = sgn(best[0] - s[0])
    dy = sgn(best[1] - s[1])
    cand.append([dx, dy])
    cand.append([dx, 0])
    cand.append([0, dy])
    cand.append([1, 0])
    cand.append([-1, 0])
    cand.append([0, 1])
    cand.append([0, -1])
    cand.append([0, 0])

    near_enemy = abs(s[0] - o[0]) + abs(s[1] - o[1]) <= 2
    if near_enemy:
        cand = [[sgn(s[0] - o[0]), sgn(s[1] - o[1])], [sgn(s[0] - o[0]), 0], [0, sgn(s[1] - o[1])]] + cand

    seen = set()
    for mv in cand:
        key = (mv[0], mv[1])
        if key in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(key)
        nx, ny = s[0] + mv[0], s[1] + mv[1]
        if bad(nx, ny):
            continue
        if (nx, ny) in sp or (nx, ny) in oppp:
            continue
        return [mv[0], mv[1]]

    return [0, 0]
